Who’s welding

One bloke.

AJG Welding is me, Aidan. I quit my job to go all in on myself, and since then it’s been full throttle: hospital shutdowns, plant rooms, pre-fab in the workshop, and a frankly unreasonable amount of carrying the welder about.

Speak weld.

Root

The first pass. Nobody sees it. It matters most.

Cap

The last pass. The one that ends up on Instagram.

Purge

Filling the pipe with argon so the inside of a stainless weld isn’t a crusty mess.

Coded

Tested and certified to weld pressure pipework. Not a vibe, a certificate.

Shutdown

When the system’s off and everyone’s looking at their watch.

Block & bleed

Two valves and a vent, so “isolated” actually means isolated.
